Package pokemonjavaedition

Class MainMenu

java.lang.Object
pokemonjavaedition.MainMenu
public class MainMenu extends Object
It creates all the menus of the game and use all the others classes to make everything work. It's the core of the game.

    • finishMenu

      public void finishMenu(String finishType, Player winner, Player loser)
      Adds and sets a panel which works as a sort of transition between a match and another and it's also used at the end of the battle.
      Parameters:
      finishType - it can be match, or end. If match it goes to the next match of the battle. If end it ends the battle.
      winner - it's the player who won the match
      loser - it's the player who lost the match

    • turnMenu

      public void turnMenu(Player p, int position, boolean stop)
      It manages the choices done in the choiceMenu, showing a label which describes what's happening in that turn.
      Parameters:
      p - The player with his choice to be analyzed
      position - the south position of the label
      stop - a boolean value to check when to stop the method in some cases.
